text: Retrieval augmented generation retrieves relevant source passages before an answer is generated. Grounding an answer in retrieved context helps reduce unsupported claims.
A vector index stores numeric representations of text so semantically related passages can be retrieved efficiently.
BM25 is a lexical retrieval algorithm that gives useful weight to uncommon query terms appearing in a document.
Speech to text transcribes spoken audio into text before it is passed to a retrieval system.
